episodes.title: Season 1: The Big Bang
episodes.description: Trace the universe's beginnings and the emergence of matter after the Big Bang.

episodes.title: Season 1: Exploring the Universe
episodes.description: Follow the early universe from hydrogen and helium to stars, galaxies, heavier elements, and planets.

episodes.title: Season 1: The Sun & The Earth
episodes.description: Explore the solar nebula and the development of the Sun, Earth, and neighboring planets.

episodes.title: Season 1: Life Begins
episodes.description: Follow early organisms as life develops from simple cells into more complex forms.

episodes.title: Season 1: The Evolutionary Epic
episodes.description: Connect Darwin's ideas and natural selection with the diversification of life over billions of years.

episodes.title: Season 1: Human Evolution
episodes.description: Trace human evolution in Africa, including toolmaking, larger brains, and the control of fire.

episodes.title: Season 1: Migrations and Intensification
episodes.description: Explore human migration, collective learning, and the innovations that supported agriculture.

episodes.title: Season 1: The Modern Revolution
episodes.description: Examine recent centuries of exploration, machinery, communication, and energy use through collective learning.

episodes.title: Season 1: The Anthropocene and the Near Future
episodes.description: Weigh the environmental, social, and political consequences of humanity's rapid modern transformation.

episodes.title: Season 1: The Deep Future
episodes.description: Consider humanity's future alongside the eventual fate of Earth, the Sun, and the universe.

episodes.title: Season 2: Why Cosmic Evolution Matters
episodes.description: Emily Graslie connects cosmic evolution with the conditions that make human lives possible.

episodes.title: Season 2: Why Star Stuff Matters
episodes.description: Discover how stellar element formation, especially carbon, enabled more complex structures and living things.

episodes.title: Season 2: Why the Evolutionary Epic Matters
episodes.description: Connect life's evolutionary history and mass extinctions with humanity's place in the world.

episodes.title: Season 2: Why Human Evolution Matters
episodes.description: Examine how communication and cumulative innovation give humans unusual power and responsibility.

episodes.title: Season 2: Why Human Ancestry Matters
episodes.description: Explore human genealogy and ancestry within the larger story of our species.

episodes.title: Season 2: Why Early Globalization Matters
episodes.description: Examine centuries of growing global connections and their relationship with collective learning.
